data.name: Lameesha
data.gender_notes: Lameesha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'l-m-s', meaning 'to be gentle, to be tender'. In Islamic tradition, the name Lameesha is given to a girl born with delicate features and a gentle disposition. The name Lameesha carries the meaning “Delicate, Tender, Fragile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lameesha usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender, fragile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lameesha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Tender, Fragile.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lameesha total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
